[[Shing Jea Sherman]] shouts various quotes about the titles that nearby characters have achieved. In Alcazia Tangle, you can choose to have him follow you by talking to him. He will only observe and comment.

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Alcazia Tangle}} (right outside Tarnished Haven)
**{{NPC location|Tarnished Haven}}

==Dialogue==
;Tarnished Haven
:''"Oh, hello. What are you doing lollygagging in town? Shouldn't you be out there slaying beast and breaking a sweat? My deadline is almost here!"''

;Alcazia Tangle
:''"Oh, hello. I bet you're wondering what such a famous personality is doing all the way out here. No, no. I don't do autographs. That would just cheapen the mood.''

:''I'm working on a new piece for the '''Monastery Gazette'''. A sexy exposé on all things adventurous. I can tell by your smell that you're on a mission...or out of soap. How I would love to follow you on your exploits. Watch you destroy your enemies with ruthless impunity; witness how you scrub those tough-to-clean blood stains off your armor. Allow me the privilege to tag along and '''observe''', would you?"''
::{{yes}}'''Sure. Tag along.'''
::{{no|red}}'''No thanks.'''

:After inviting the Sherman to follow the player character after a party [[wipe]] {{verify|trigger unknown: is it just the player dying, or is it the entire party that causes him to stop following you}}
::''"Hey. Alright, then. You work on the killing and I'll work on my fawning."''
::''"Come on, you can do better!"''

==Notes==
* Shing Jea Sherman will be healed before he can be killed; he will never die and can make a good ally to keep around as enemies will still attack him.
* Sherman currently does not notice [[Zaishen rank|Zaishen]] and [[Codex rank]] titles.

==Trivia==
* This character was designed by [[User:Bobby Stein|Bobby Stein]], [[Colin Johanson]] and [[John Corpening]].
* The Luxon Allegiance quote is a reference to [[w:Fight Club|Fight Club]].
* The Lightbringer quote is a reference to the song [[w:The Future's So Bright, I Gotta Wear Shades|The Future's So Bright, I Gotta Wear Shades]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive&oldid=371774#Trivia_Check source]).
* The Party Animal quote is a reference to [[w:Animal House|National Lampoon's Animal House]].
* He will sometimes dance. Uses warrior emotes.
* The name refers to the character of Jay Sherman on the animated comedy series "[[W:The Critic|The Critic]]".
* The [[Party Animal]] title track was originally ignored by Shing Jea Sherman (since it was added after the release of ''Eye of the North''). After wiki users reported the anomaly, it was added into Sherman's repertoire on [[Talk:Shing Jea Sherman#Drunk+party animal title?|24th of April 2008]].
